subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: What visibility contract should OpenClaw support for chat `/status` and `session_status`: whole-card hiding, structured JSON-only output, per-agent/section suppression, or no new config surface?
rationale: The request adds public config and changes security-sensitive status disclosure, so source inspection cannot safely choose the permanent product/API boundary.

options.title: Per-agent or per-section visibility
options.body: Add a scoped visibility model that can suppress usage/cost or other sensitive sections while preserving the existing card by default.

options.title: Whole-card boolean or JSON-only mode
options.body: Add the smallest requested toggle, accepting that it may not fully solve the multi-agent privacy case from the superseded related issue.

options.title: Reject new config surface
options.body: Keep `/status` and `session_status` as explicit diagnostic surfaces and close the product direction as not planned.

recommendation.title: Per-agent or per-section visibility
recommendation.body: Add a scoped visibility model that can suppress usage/cost or other sensitive sections while preserving the existing card by default.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced `session_status`, has recent status-path ownership, and previously reviewed this canonical tracker.
